concepts_synthesized.circuit_breaker_state_machine: Closed (normal traffic; trips when failures exceed threshold) -> Open (instant fail-fast/fallback protecting struggling dependency; waits reset timeout) -> Half-Open (allows single probe; closes on success, re-opens on failure).
concepts_synthesized.exponential_backoff_with_jitter: Exponential delay doubles recovery headroom (100ms, 200ms, 400ms, 800ms), while randomized jitter desynchronizes retry waves across thousands of clients to eliminate thundering herd collapse.
concepts_synthesized.blast_radius_isolation: Non-critical dependencies (e.g., recommendation widgets, secondary notification providers, cache) must have tight timeouts, circuit breakers, and explicit fallbacks so their failure never degrades core revenue or redirect paths.
